info.name: Invoice Generator Backend API
info.description: Complete Postman collection generated from the backend OpenAPI schema. Default baseUrl targets local development (http://localhost:8000). Do not point this collection at production unless you intend to make real changes. Auth uses access/refresh cookies captured by the collection scripts; CSRF is echoed on write requests. Start with Register, then GET Organizations if organization_id was not automatically captured. Resource IDs are captured from successful create requests. For real email, use an inbox you control and set reset_token/verification_token from delivered messages. Run migrations through the documented CLI before using Settings/Profile requests.

request.description:
Unauthenticated, unrestricted endpoint for the frontend to check that
it can reach the backend at all (network/CORS sanity check) — separate
from /health/db, which also proves the database connection works.
IRREVERSIBLE: permanently deletes this user and all eligible owned-organization data. Use only on a disposable account after confirming the organization has no other members.
